title: Hotel Catalina
content: Hotel Catalina, oil, 8 x 12 inches, Catalina IslandI painted this view of Hotel Catalina about 35 years ago. The layers of paint are fairly thinly applied on a panel that was pre-primed with a warm acrylic ground. For the window details, I used a 1/4 inch synthetic flat brush, usingLiquinfor the medium.
